title: All Time High, Lessons of Regret
theme: Pizza Day 2022 · ATH reflections / personal vice
description: 2022 Bitcoin Pizza Day single. New all-time highs in the 2021–2022 epoch brought reflections on crypto losses and what old bitcoin was spent on. For Robbie P the “high” is a play on words — a prior weed addiction as much as a price print.
